Choose your destination and connect over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi. Virtual and physical controls work together automatically.
• For a new PC, allow phone visibility and add the phone in its Bluetooth settings.
• Use the virtual gamepad or connect a physical controller to the phone.
Bluetooth HID support varies by Android device and may require Steam configuration. Wi-Fi requires BridgePad Desktop. USB output is not available yet.

Reads compatible USB HID controllers directly. You can leave the app or turn off the screen. This is input from the controller, not USB output to the PC.

Physical gamepad active. Keep BridgePad open and the screen on while playing.
Background USB active. You can keep playing with the app minimized or the screen off.

Customize the position and size of the controls shown while playing.
Tap a control to select it. Drag the side handles to change one dimension or a corner handle to change both.
Choose a ready-made layout, then customize it if you want. Changes are only applied when saved.

Start the diagnostic BridgePad Desktop receiver on a PC connected to the same network. Enter its local IP address, port and certificate fingerprint below. The test sends 250 encrypted Ping/Pong samples at 125 Hz.
Copy the complete fingerprint printed by BridgePad Desktop. A different certificate will be rejected.
